summary: Implemented the deprecation decorators. Added monai/utils/deprecate_utils.py with deprecated (functions, methods, classes), deprecated_arg (single named argument), and DeprecatedError. Warns with DeprecationWarning when since <= version < removed, and raises DeprecatedError when version >= removed. Exported from monai/utils/__init__.py. Added tests/test_deprecated.py; all 8 tests pass with the generator venv. Limitations: deprecated_arg only detects keyword-passed arguments; version_val defaults to monai.__version__, which is "0+unknown" in this environment. Wider test suite not run. Nothing committed.
